description: Road accidents and casualties in Punjab is a data set listed in opendata.com.pk, an open data portal, published or maintained by Computer-Human Interaction and Social Experience Lab (CHISEL) @ LUMS. Showing and analyzing the data of accidents and casualties of Punjab district wise of 2011and 2019. Other factors such a population, motor vehicles registered, road length, and area are taken into account. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher Computer-Human Interaction and Social Experience Lab (CHISEL) @ LUMS. Its tags are accidents, casualties, fatal, injured, killed. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2021-04-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-pk-portal.
